name: tokenade-product
install_doc: `npm install -g @tokenade/cli`, then `tokenade install`. The image installs the pinned CLI. Each run executes the vendor's own non-interactive installer, restricted to the agent being measured, in the run's sandboxed HOME and workspace. Measured 2026-11-14: no account is needed. It writes settings.json hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreCompact, SessionStart, SubagentStop, UserPromptSubmit), a statusLine, its auto-compact window, a global CLAUDE.md, and the workspace's AGENTS.md and .gitignore entries.
notes: Tokenade as shipped, not THOL's `tokenade` entry. That entry is a hand-written replica of what 0.8.13 installed, and the earlier ledger campaign ran only Tokenade's rules text. TOKENADE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE keeps the CLI on the pin for the whole campaign; it changes no compaction behaviour.
